scripts.test: pnpm run build && node test/run-tests.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: pnpm run build && c8 --all --clean --temp-directory coverage/.tmp --extension .js --include 'dist/**/*.js' --exclude 'dist/**/*.d.ts' --exclude 'scripts/**' --reporter=none --reports-dir coverage node test/run-tests.mjs && c8 --all --clean false --temp-directory coverage/.tmp --extension .js --include 'dist/**/*.js' --exclude 'dist/**/*.d.ts' --exclude 'scripts/**' --reporter=none --reports-dir coverage node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs && c8 report --temp-directory coverage/.tmp --exclude 'scripts/**' --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --reports-dir coverage
scripts.ci: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run test
